summary: VM create wizard defaults install media ahead of disks in boot order when an ISO is first chosen. API impact: none — same create payload; only the Controller UI default order changes.

guide.reason: create-virtual-machine.md now states install media is first by default instead of telling operators to move it up.

api.reason: API impact: none. Create still sends the same boot.media_boot_order and disk boot_order fields; only the wizard's default ordering when media_id is set changes.

roadmap.reason: Default UX only; no milestone or acceptance gate change.

state.reason: No new durable state; boot order remains host-owned on the VM definition once created.

verification.method: npm --prefix web run test (vm-create.test.mjs asserts fresh media sorts first and renumbers to media=1/disk=2; restored explicit order preserved). python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree.
